title: [proposal] Web render guard: research/provisional sections never render as LIVE/FROZEN (G3)
body:
## Defect (GIE-006 §4, G3)

`product/web_mvp.py` `validate_bundle` (L25-67) does not apply the research/provisional rule that `producers/contract.py` applies (L197-202, `RESEARCH_STATUSES`, `ResearchStatusError`). A hand-built schema-1 bundle with a section in state `LIVE` and `producer.methodology.status = PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH` passes the validator and `web_mvp.build`, and the pre-guard `app.js` showed it under a `LIVE` badge with its values.

**Probe, reproduced here:** `tools/build_web_research_guard_fixture.py` passes this kind of bundle through the unchanged `web_mvp.build`. With the pre-guard `app.js` (blob at `f8af596`, sha256 `7944757a…3dbead9`), the DOM contains `11.11`, `22.22`, `66.66`, `77.77` and every `RESEARCH_PROBE_*` token on home, portfolio, leaderboard, news and company/nvda, in ko-KR and en-US. With the guard, none of them appear.

## Change (render time, in `app.js` only)

- `guardSections(data)` runs once, when `data.json` loads. Any section in `('universe', *SECTIONS)` whose state is `LIVE` or `FROZEN_SNAPSHOT` and that carries a research marker is replaced in the **view** by the existing `NOT_AVAILABLE` presentation: `as_of`, `source` and `data` become null.
- That section then shows a localized reason, the marker path and the marker status, for example `producer.methodology.status: PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH`. Its values never reach the DOM, including the Evidence `<pre>`.
  - ko: "게시 승인이 없는 연구·잠정 결과라 표시하지 않습니다."
  - en: "Withheld: research or provisional output without publication approval."
- The served `data.json` is not rewritten, because the guard works on a copy.
- If the universe is withheld, the companies legend and the global search state no longer show `FROZEN_SNAPSHOT`.
- `locale.js` gains one UI string. `style.css` is unchanged.

### Markers mirrored exactly (no new status values, no new policy)

| Marker | Source (exact SHA) |
|---|---|
| States guarded: `PUBLISHED_STATES = ('LIVE','FROZEN_SNAPSHOT')` | `producers/contract.py` L26 @ f8af596 |
| Status set: `RESEARCH_STATUSES = {PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH, IDEA, RESEARCH, PROVISIONAL, PROVISIONAL_INITIAL_PRIOR}` | `producers/contract.py` L28-30, `contracts/enums.py` L33-43 |
| Sections: `SECTION_NAMES = ('universe', *SECTIONS)` | `producers/contract.py` L23 |
| Rule: published state + `methodology.status` in the set → reject | `producers/contract.py` L197-202 |
| Bundle path: `<section>.producer.methodology.status` | `producers/assembler.py` L31 (`_meta`), L47 (`env['producer']`) |
| `research_state.status` in the same set, anywhere in the section | Persisted-record lifecycle. On #17, `publication/extractors.py` L52-55 and L92-95 copy it verbatim as `methodology_lifecycle`, and `predicate.py` L63 checks it against the same `RESEARCH_STATUSES`. On #30, `leaderboard_producer/infra_boundary.py` L88 and L149 map it to producer `methodology.status` |

**Reviewer decision point:** `producers/contract.py` itself rejects only `methodology.status`. The `research_state.status` check uses the same constant set at the path where the repo already stores the same lifecycle. It can only withhold a section, never display one. If the owner wants a strict contract-only mirror, remove that one branch in `researchMarker`.

### P01 `publication_envelope` (#17)

The envelope is a top-level key. Its `decisions` are keyed by `subject_sha256`, not by section, and always carry `schema1_data_state = NOT_AVAILABLE`. It has no per-section lifecycle field, so the guard does not read it. It also never uses the envelope to display anything: `DISPLAY_RESEARCH` stays inactive.

### `tests/test_web_research_guard.py` pins the mirror

- The `app.js` constants must equal `contract.RESEARCH_STATUSES`, `PUBLISHED_STATES` and `SECTION_NAMES`.
- Every fixture section that carries `methodology.status` must be rejected by `validate_snapshot` (`ResearchStatusError`) if and only if the guard withholds it.
- The fixture exercises all five statuses.

## Not changed

- `product/web_mvp.py`: untouched. It is byte-pinned by #17's protected digest and by `tests/test_web_mvp.py`.
- `producers/*`: untouched.
- No schema-1 state is added. The view only reuses `NOT_AVAILABLE`, and `STATES` is unchanged.
- No grant is created, `DISPLAY_RESEARCH` is not activated, and no Research, Frozen or Live grant exists.
- No score, rank, regime, zone or portfolio value is computed or transformed. The diff has no arithmetic on those fields.
- `DEMO` sections are not guarded, because the contract permits research status in `DEMO`. For the owner: P01-H says research bytes are not relabelled `DEMO`, but enforcing that is not part of this mirror.
- Top-level `companies` (including `market_cap_rank`) is not a section and is not guarded.
- No Track C paths, codex/* branches or owner branches are touched. No Holdout or CAL_VERIFY access.

## Follow-up: validator hardening (separate)

The defense-in-depth fix is to apply the same rule in `web_mvp.validate_bundle`. That changes `product/web_mvp.py`, which is part of #17's protected digest (`tests/test_p01_research_publication.py`, `test_protected_engine_bytes_are_unchanged`, `PROTECTED_DIGEST_PRE_ADOPTION` / `PROTECTED_DIGEST_C28_ADOPTED`, around L436 on #30) and of `tests/test_web_mvp.py` (around L75). So that follow-up needs an additive digest re-pin on #17 and its descendants.

It also needs `tools/build_web_research_guard_fixture.py` to inject the hand-built bundle after the build instead of through `build()`. The browser guard stays useful even then, for a hand-placed `data.json`.

## Other G3-area gaps, not addressed here

- `STALE` is only appended inside the `LIVE` badge, and `style.css` has no `LIVE`/`STALE` rule.
- `FRESH` has no label.
- The loading text in `index.html` is not localized.
- Hard-coded strings remain in `app.js` and `network-bridge.js`.
- Render errors after `hashchange` are uncaught.

## Tests (actually executed locally; Python 3.11.15, Node v22.22.0, Playwright 1.56.1 with Chromium 141.0.7390.37 preinstalled. The workflows pin playwright@1.58.2, which was **NOT_RUN** here)

On this branch (`2b53b27`):

- **Full pytest:** `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rf` gives **435 passed**. The #9 tip `f8af596` gives 431 passed, so this is 431 + 4 new.
- **Existing web workflow commands, unchanged and against the guarded `app.js`:**
  - `global_language_search_test.js`: 26 checks PASS

  - `global_language_search_browser_test.js`: 8 checks PASS
- **New browser test, `tools/web_research_guard_browser_test.js`:**
  - Fixture mode, ko and en, all routes: 9 checks PASS. In this mode:
    - (a) `LIVE` sections with a research methodology status are withheld: qgv `PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH`, changes `IDEA`, news `PROVISIONAL_INITIAL_PRIOR`.
    - (b) `FROZEN_SNAPSHOT` sections with a research marker are withheld: technical `PROVISIONAL`, and leaderboard rows with `research_state` `PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH`.
    - Withheld sections show no `LIVE`/`FROZEN` badge and no probe value.
    - (c) The valid `LIVE` macro section (`VALIDATED`) and the legacy `FROZEN` universe render.
    - (d) `DEMO` portfolio and `NOT_AVAILABLE` relationships render.
    - A universe variant with status `RESEARCH`, served by route interception, is withheld.
  - With `--baseline-app` set to the pre-guard `app.js`: 11 checks PASS. Every card or pane that is not withheld, and the page outside the cards, is byte-identical to the pre-guard rendering. The same bundle leaks under the pre-guard `app.js`.
  - `--mode legacy` against the default build and the demo build: PASS. Rendering is byte-identical to the pre-guard `app.js` on all routes in ko and en, and nothing is withheld.

- **Actions on PR #34 head `2b53b27`:** `web-research-guard` [run 37109567406](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/actions/runs/37109567406) **success** (playwright@1.58.2). `web-mvp-validation` [run 37109567361](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/actions/runs/37109567361) **success** (full pytest + existing browser tests). title: QGV Real Producer v1: per-company PIT persistence, batch manifest, exporter
body:
## Purpose

This PR does not change how QGV is calculated. It saves the existing QGV engine output, computed from the Frozen real PIT data, along this path:

**engine → observe-only capture → per-company result → deterministic persistence → batch manifest → exporter**

Nothing else is changed:
- QGV methodology, Q/G/V calculation, ranking and selection
- the Official Universe
- Track A Frozen evidence (`reports/gate_evidence`, `data/raw`)
- Track B/C/D/E, Technical, Macro, Portfolio
- Web (PR #5/#6/#7)
- Producer Infrastructure (PR #9)

Handoff docs: `implementation/docs/qgv_producer/` — `AUDIT.md` (pre-implementation audit), `CONTRACT.md` (formats, rules, integration requirements), `STATUS.md` (handoff), `evidence/validation.json`.

## Base / ancestry

- **Base:** canonical `claude/investment-system-top500-validation-alrugm@b8e39a2`. Merge-base = `b8e39a2`; 8 commits ahead, 0 behind (head `5eec129`).
- This is an independent branch. Producer Infrastructure (PR #9) is **not** an ancestor and none of its source is included. Compatibility was checked only from a separate read-only checkout, so this PR is not stacked on #9.
- **Changed files: 33, all in QGV-producer paths:**
  - `src/investment_system/qgv_producer/`
  - `tools/qgv_producer*.py`
  - `tests/test_qgv_producer*.py`
  - `docs/qgv_producer/`
  - `reports/qgv_producer/`
  - `.github/workflows/qgv-producer-real.yml`

## What was added

- **`capture`**: an observe-only wrapper around `AnalysisPipeline.analyze_raw` / `AnalysisEngine.analyze`. It passes arguments and return values through unchanged. A plain run and a captured run give identical results.
- **`record` (`QGV_COMPANY_RESULT` v1)**: stores the existing `QGVSnapshot` as-is and adds the Q/G/V sub-factors the engine actually scored, PIT timestamps, sha256 of the raw inputs, Universe identity, the engine's own rank and the research state.
  - `semantic_sha256` covers the semantic content only.
  - Operational fields (`qgv_snapshot_id` UUID, `generated_at`, `code_commit`, `run_id`) are excluded from the hash.
- **`batch`**: one PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN record for every Universe member (no silent drops), plus `QGV_PRODUCER_BATCH_MANIFEST` v1.
- **`exporter`**: validate → persist → serialize, written atomically. It never rescores, normalizes or re-ranks.
- **`infra_boundary`**: calls Producer Infrastructure's own `adapters`/`contract`. It does not create a new Snapshot/Bundle schema.

## Real-data evidence

The final run is Actions [36852186517](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/actions/runs/36852186517) on `4b772c2`, both jobs success. Its evidence was committed back as `81b87b8` (`implementation/reports/qgv_producer/`). The commits after it (`8d531fb`, `5eec129`) are docs-only, so they trigger no workflow and carry no check runs.

Raw data source: the Track A Frozen artifact `c21-raw-store-36305927245` (digest `sha256:712e43bc…f94`).

| as_of | Universe identity | Expected | Persisted | PASS | FAIL | NOT_RUN | Frozen Track A comparison |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2024-06-30 | `uni_cb35a6200b61` (Official, Frozen) | 500 | 500 | 500 | 0 | 0 | PASS: counts, universe and the 471-name selected list exact |
| 2024-09-30 | `uni_12c3852b8333` | 500 | 500 | 500 | 0 | 0 | PASS: counts, universe and the 469-name selected list exact |
| 2024-12-31 | `uni_0d1a30b1ee47` | 500 | 500 | 500 | 0 | 0 | PASS: counts and universe exact (the Frozen run saved no selected list for this date) |
| 2024-12-31 **SAMPLE** (aapl, brk_b, jpm, msft, nvda) | `uni_0d1a30b1ee47` | 5 | 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 | PASS; record hashes identical to the same companies in the FULL run. **Not a Universe validation** |

## PASS semantics

**`500/500 PASS` does NOT mean "500 companies received complete QGV scores" or "the investment strategy is validated".**

A record PASS means only that:
- the persisted record is valid (schema and semantic hash);
- PIT is valid (fundamentals `available_at` ≤ as_of and price `observed_at` ≤ as_of);
- lineage is valid (raw input sha256 = store manifest = committed `STORE_INDEX.json`);
- identity is valid (Universe `company_id`/ticker/CIK and snapshot company_id/as_of);
- semantic reconstruction is valid (the `QGVSnapshot` rebuilds byte-identically).

The engine's own `coverage_state` (READY / PARTIAL / BLOCKED) is a separate field, saved unchanged. In the actual evidence:

| as_of | READY | PARTIAL | BLOCKED | Q & G present | Neither Q nor G | V present |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2024-06-30 | **0** | 471 | 29 | 471 | 3 | 443 |
| 2024-09-30 | **0** | 469 | 31 | 469 | 5 | 443 |
| 2024-12-31 | **0** | 468 | 32 | 468 | 6 | 439 |

No company is READY. The rubric Q/G inputs have no source, so every name stays PARTIAL or BLOCKED. Missing scores stay null: there is no interpolation, forward-fill, current-value or peer substitution, or synthetic fundamentals.

## Research state

- QGV status is **`PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH`**; V is `PROVISIONAL_INITIAL_PRIOR`.
- Nothing is claimed as OFFICIAL / VALIDATED / PROMOTED / LIVE. The validator rejects any such value (`PROMOTION_FORBIDDEN`).
- Web publication state: **`NOT_AVAILABLE` / `QGV_RESEARCH_ONLY_NO_EXPORT`**.
- Producer Infrastructure rejecting the research snapshot (`ResearchStatusError`) is the **intended, correct behaviour**. Nothing bypasses the state while P01 is unapproved.

## Floating-point tolerance (first run failure, disclosed)

- **First run [36851716398](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/actions/runs/36851716398) failed.** The tool compared the Frozen **post-as_of equal-weight return** bit-for-bit, and it differed by 1.7e-18 (`-0.01529828853939469` vs `-0.015298288539394689`). This value:
  - is **not a QGV score**;
  - is a post-as_of outcome aggregate used only to prove the replay matches the Frozen run;
  - is not stored in any QGV snapshot;
  - differs only by floating-point representation.
- **Fix `4b772c2`**: that single comparison now accepts an absolute difference up to `EWR_ABS_TOL = 1e-15` and always records the exact difference (`exact_equal`, `abs_diff`, `tolerance_abs`).
- **Maximum observed difference: 8.3e-17** (06-30 8.3e-17, 09-30 3.9e-18, 12-31 1.7e-18).
- The tolerance **does not apply to** QGV score, ranking, selection, eligibility or any investment decision. Those are all compared exactly: `ranked_sha256`, `selected_sha256`, counts and the selected lists.

## Determinism / lineage

- **Reload:** all 1,500 records re-validated (file sha256, each semantic hash, manifest rows/counts). Every `QGVSnapshot` rebuilds byte-identically.
- **Re-run:** an independent second run of 2024-12-31 gave identical hashes for all 500 records and the same manifest semantic hash. Engine UUIDs differed as expected, which confirms the operational/semantic split.
- **Sample vs full:** sample records are hash-identical to the same names in the FULL run, because the sample also runs the full cross-section.
- **Universe identity:** the gate-evidence `universe_id` is pinned. `load_official` checks exact members and order. The Track A freeze manifest's `universe_id` must match. The universe id is part of the semantic hash.
- **Peer context:** V's peer median depends on the whole cross-section, so the manifest's `data_lineage.inputs_sha256` covers all 1,000 inputs per date.
- **Raw source hashes:** each input's actual bytes are hashed and must match the store manifest and the committed `STORE_INDEX.json`.
- **Network-blocked replay:** sockets are refused (0 attempts on every date). A missing input can never be fetched live.

## Producer Infrastructure compatibility (PR #9)

- This PR does not modify or include PR #9.
- CI checks out `feature/producer-infrastructure-v1@5fa7ce0` read-only and runs the Infrastructure's own validators. Result: PASS on full and sample. During this PR audit, the same check also passed locally against the current PR #9 HEAD `6fe9eee`; the commits after `5fa7ce0` don't touch `src`.
  - `adapters.qgv_section` produces an ENTITY_MAP that includes every Web-read field.
  - Canonical serialization hashes agree.
  - File inputs re-verify.
  - `assemble_bundle` + `web_mvp.validate_bundle` pass.
  - INFO: ids from earlier dates are outside the 2024-12-31 Web company list.
- So the QGV producer implementation is **compatible**, but `PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH` → Infrastructure publication is **blocked** (intended).
- An in-memory shape probe with the status relabelled (never written) passes, which shows research status is the only blocker.
- After P01 is approved, the integration owner does the actual registration and publication.
- Integration requirements IR-1…IR-7 are in `CONTRACT.md`. They include IR-3: the snapshot UUID inside the Infrastructure's `data_sha256` makes identical results look changed on every run.

## Readiness

| State | Verdict |
|---|---|
| QGV_PER_COMPANY_PERSISTENCE_READY | **YES** |
| QGV_EXPORTER_READY | **YES** |
| QGV_BATCH_READY | **YES (3 Frozen as-of only)** |
| PRODUCER_INFRA_COMPATIBLE | **YES** (read-only dependency, unmerged) |
| REAL_QGV_RESEARCH_PRODUCER_READY | **YES** (research grade, export-blocked) |
| OFFICIAL_QGV_PRODUCER_READY | **NO**: Track C incomplete (C7–C10); P01 unresolved; current QGV status `PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH` |

## Blockers (no policy decided here)

- **P01**: Web/Producer data state for research outputs.
- **P02**: no Universe after 2024-12-31 and no carry-forward policy. No Universe was created.
- **P03**: raw-store durability. The only blob copy (the artifact) **expires 2026-12-26**; after that, real re-runs are impossible.
- **Track C C7–C10**: no result assumed, Holdout not read, no Investor-QGV ProfileConfig applied.
- **SEC companyfacts restatement limitation**: `SEC_COMPANYFACTS_VALUE_MAY_BE_RESTATED` is recorded in every record.

## Tests

- **New QGV Producer tests:** 28 (`test_qgv_producer.py`, `test_qgv_producer_infra_compat.py`). They cover:
  - PASS path and identity;
  - exact Q/G/V and sub-factor preservation; methodology versions;
  - PIT violations (record-level and the engine's own lookahead abort);
  - missing provenance and hash mismatch;
  - synthetic/real mismatch; promotion forbidden; outcome leak;
  - semantic-hash determinism; different as_of; Universe identity in the hash;
  - sample == full;
  - exporter doesn't modify scores/ranking; partial batch reported; atomic failure.
- **Full regression: 424/424** with pytest (Infrastructure compat enabled) and with mini_pytest (baseline 396 + 28). Both pass locally and in CI. No existing test was changed or loosened.
- **Real-data Actions:**
  - Stage 1: sample E2E.
  - Stage 2: FULL for 3 dates, each with a plain-engine fingerprint vs the captured run.
  - Stage 3: determinism re-run.
  - Stage 4: Infrastructure compat.
  - Plus a CI guard: `git diff --exit-code -- reports/gate_evidence data/raw`.
- **Numerical/ranking invariance:**
  - plain = captured `ranked_sha256` / `selected_sha256` on all dates;
  - persisted Q/G/V exactly equal the engine values;
  - Frozen counts and selected lists exact.

## Cross-track

The diff against canonical was re-audited: Track A, B, C, D, E, Technical, Macro, Portfolio, Web (#5/#6/#7) and Producer Infrastructure (#9) are all unchanged.

**Do not merge automatically.** This PR records the implementation baseline and then waits for integration (P01, PR #9 merge order, Track C).
